periods.time: Two days before Seven Stars opening ceremony

name.zh: 一辉首战抽中诸星雄大
name.en: Ikki draws Yuudai Moroboshi for round one

periods.location: Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival bracket announcement
periods.summary: The final Seven Stars participant count becomes thirty-two after withdrawals. When the bracket is announced, Ikki's first opponent is revealed to be Bukyoku Academy third-year Yuudai Moroboshi, the reigning Seven Stars Sword King and current pinnacle of Japanese student knights.
periods.cause: The altered tournament proceeds with Akatsuki admitted and representative withdrawals resolved.
periods.outcome: Ikki begins the tournament path against the defending champion, immediately raising the stakes of his campaign.
periods.significance: Final cliffhanger of the volume and setup for the next tournament battle.
